name.fallback: Erratic Blaze King: Giant Cartwheel Prison

lang.ability.jojorpg.abdominal_machine_gun.de: A machine gun inside Stroheim's stomach region, able to shoot 600 armor-piercing rounds per minute, and capable of piercing a steel plate. Stroheim first introduces this weapon against Kars.
lang.ability.jojorpg.afterimages.desc: Those who have trained in Sendō gain extremely quick movements, footwork, and agility, allowing Dire to create afterimages when he moves.
lang.ability.jojorpg.anti_ripple_wires.desc: Wamuu's head gear is specially designed to be an "Anti-Ripple Tool". The head gear contains wires that Wamuu used to nullify Caesar's Ripple-charged bubbles, by spinning his head and knocking the bubbles away. Also, the head gear has a hole that opens up allowing his horn to drill out, enabling him
lang.ability.jojorpg.axe_wielding.desc: Winzaleo wields a giant battle-axe and is notable for being skilled with axes. He is capable of using it with either one or two hands. His attacks consist of swinging the axe, slamming it on the ground, and thrusting it forward. By slamming his axe on the ground, he can create several seismic waves.
lang.ability.jojorpg.body_spikes.desc: As a vampire, Wired Beck has complete control of every aspect of his body. His main form of attacking is by sharpening the hair protruding out of his limbs into spikes. Coupled with his unorthodox speed, Wired Beck is capable of lunging at his opponents and delivering them a lethal embrace.
lang.ability.jojorpg.bubble_barrier.desc: Sometimes used in conjunction with Bubble Launcher; the difference is that instead of multiple being used in a barrage, Caesar conjures a single gigantic bubble capable of absorbing and trapping its target.
lang.ability.jojorpg.bubble_cutter.desc: Based on his grandfather's Ripple Cutter, this technique is a direct improvement on the Bubble Launcher, and creates bubbles with the ability to slice. Unlike the original attack, the bubbles spin at high speed and use centrifugal force, but are able to stay intact due to the Ripple. This causes the
lang.ability.jojorpg.bubble_cutter_gliding.de: A more versatile version of Bubble Cutter, Caesar sacrifices the quantity of the attack, and focuses on effectiveness. By launching a few bubbles, he is able to aim them much like homing projectiles. They are able to go around objects and have a higher chance of hitting the opponent.
lang.ability.jojorpg.bubble_launcher.desc: Caesar fires out a barrage of bubbles from their gloves, each coated in the Ripple. This increases the density of the bubbles and allows them to hit objects with a greater impact. When hit by the barrage, a grown man would be completely blown away.
lang.ability.jojorpg.bubble_lenses.desc: Caesar produces Ripple-infused bubbles that have the ability to refract light and focus them into beams, much like a magnifying glass. After launching them, the bubbles become stationary and any light source passing through will cause a domino effect, connecting the bubbles together and eventually s
lang.ability.jojorpg.cat_foot_stance.desc: Caesar instinctively assumes a special defensive stance by relaxing his legs and feet, allowing him to pounce in any direction with greater speed and agility. Known as the "Cat-Foot Stance", the posture is commonly used in Kenpō, though Caesar himself has never received formal training in it.
lang.ability.jojorpg.clacker_boomerang.desc: Joseph throws both pairs of clackers infused with the Ripple into a beam or pillar behind the opponent, fooling the foe into assuming that he missed. One gets stuck onto whatever it was thrown on and starts spinning, latching onto the second pair of clackers. The second pair then flings back towards
lang.ability.jojorpg.clacker_volley.desc: Joseph chucks clackers infused with the Ripple into his opponent's direction. This can be done a number of ways, but to produce the best and most surprising effect, he can hide them behind his back. From there, Joseph can slingshot them from behind his back at the enemy in all directions.
lang.ability.jojorpg.claws.desc: In battle, Wang Chan chooses to wear gloves with long claws to increase his power and attack range. He is confident in his ability to kill a human by a single swipe of his rigid claws, though he still needs to attack from a relatively-close distance. This is omitted in the anime.
lang.ability.jojorpg.cyborg_eyes.desc: Stroheim's right eye incorporated several lenses allowing him to zoom on an object and notice minute details. This ability only appears in the anime.
lang.ability.jojorpg.danse_macab_hair.desc: Through unknown means, Bruford developed a technique that allowed him to use his hair in combat as a weapon while he was still alive. His hair acted as a third arm, able to entwine things and serve as a distraction. His standard method of fighting consisted of using his hair first and following with
lang.ability.jojorpg.deep_pass_overdrive.desc: Zeppeli's last and most powerful Ripple technique. Right before his death, he transfers all his life energy into Jonathan. Using this technique, Jonathan obtains all of Zeppeli's power - causing his strength, agility, and Ripple technique to increase dramatically. This rapid loss of life energy natu
lang.ability.jojorpg.divine_sandstorm.desc: Wamuu's signature technique. The Mode is initiated when Wamuu starts to spin his forearms rapidly from the elbow joint, spinning his right arm to the left and his left to the right. The vacuum created between both arms by their rapid centrifugal motion creates a massive wind storm, bearing enough de
lang.ability.jojorpg.eastern_mystery_chinese_: Amato does a flying kick toward his opponent. According to him, it sends his opponents flying to the netherworld, implying that it's a strong attack. However, it can easily be countered if the enemy is not caught off guard.
lang.ability.jojorpg.electrified_halberd.desc: Eijkman utilizes a halberd which can generate electricity to paralyze his opponents. His thrusts have enough force to shoot out gusts of wind.
lang.ability.jojorpg.erratic_blaze_king.desc: After boiling his own blood, Esidisi extends his blood vessels outside of his body, turning them into long, prehensile needles with which he injects his boiling blood into enemies. He can also use his blood vessels as extra limbs, as shown when he uses them to cut Joseph's string.
lang.ability.jojorpg.erratic_blaze_king_giant: Erratic Blaze King: Giant Cartwheel Prison

After creating several holes in his back, Esidisi makes a huge spinning jump while extending his blood vessels out of the newly created holes, similarly to a hedgehog's spines. He then attacks by using his blood vessels to surround his enemies, giving them little room to escape.
lang.ability.jojorpg.final_mode_atmospheric_r: A Mode typically used as a last resort. Wamuu uses the tubes for his wind suit to gather huge amounts of air and compresses it in his lungs. The air is then released through a slit on the horn of his head, causing it to become as sharp as a razor blade. The wind flails about much like a whip and is
lang.ability.jojorpg.flesh_transmutation.desc: Having extensive knowledge on the anatomies of organic beings, Dio can graft the body parts of different beings together. Initially, he uses this ability to create hybrid animal chimeras that he keeps as pets, as well as deformed zombies such as Doobie, Page, Jones, Plant, and Bornnam. Dio later uti
Zeppeli gut punches someone with his little finger raised, allowing him to reach their diaphragm. By doing so, the target will momentarily lose their breath and be in agony, but will be able to produce the Ripple. Wounds sustained by a normal person can be healed faster. One can also gauge how much
lang.ability.jojorpg.head_twisting.desc: Adams is capable of twisting his head 180 degrees.
lang.ability.jojorpg.healing.desc: The Ripple can heal fractured bones as well as lessen one's sense of pain. When Jonathan grabs a tree branch, it revives withered flowers, causing them to bloom again. During his battle with Tarkus, he was also able to heal his broken neck after receiving the Deep Pass Overdrive from Zeppeli.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hell_heaven_snake_kill.d: Tarkus's signature method of execution in the Chain Neck Deathmatch. Jumping above his opponent, Tarkus manipulates his chain to strike from below, cornering the opponent from both sides. The chain wraps around the opponent; once Tarkus lands, he pulls on the chain with enough force to tear a human
lang.ability.jojorpg.hypnosis.desc: Dio is able to hypnotize living people into obeying his commands, visually represented by beams appearing from his eyes. The effect is shown to wear off if the hypnotized person is struck with Ripple energy. Dio uses this ability to convince Jack the Ripper to become his servant, and later to lure J
lang.ability.jojorpg.indigo_blue_overdrive.de: Lisa Lisa charges Ripple into her fist and hits the ground. The Ripple travels across the floor, creating a circle filled with a complicated pattern. It instantly disintegrates Alejandro Torres into ashes.
lang.ability.jojorpg.intangibility.desc: Wired Beck can camouflage with objects and also phase through them. He does so with a door and sticks his hand out to mimic a doorknob in order to catch Joseph and Lisa Lisa off guard with a surprise attack.
lang.ability.jojorpg.life_magnetism_overdrive: Human bodies have a faint magnetic field, allowing them to act as a living magnet when the power of the magnetic field is increased by this Overdrive. That magnetic field is then transferred into the leaves, creating a massive magnetic sheet. With the aid of Zeppeli, Jonathan uses this technique to
lang.ability.jojorpg.light_blades.desc: Kars is able to produce bladed appendages from his arms and legs and use these to reflect blinding light toward his enemies. The light comes from the reflections of tiny, shark teeth-like claws running along the edges of the blades, much like a chainsaw. Kars's blades are sharp enough to cut through
lang.ability.jojorpg.light_body.desc: Kars can emanate a bright light from his body. He can make specific body parts glow, such as his hands, to use as signals, and in combat he can disappear in a flash of light.
lang.ability.jojorpg.luck.desc: As a knight, Bruford was fairly proficient in using swords, having defeated several people during the trial of the 77 Rings. After being revived as a zombie, Bruford wields a sword named Luck. When swung, the blade curves significantly to demonstrate its velocity. After being defeated, he gives it t
lang.ability.jojorpg.luck_and_pluck.desc: After his defeat, Bruford gave Jonathan his sword. It played a major role in the final battle against Dio, where Jonathan was able to counter Dio's freezing ability by infusing the sword with Ripple, in order to avoid direct contact with Dio's body.
lang.ability.jojorpg.meat_invade.desc: Also called Malevolent Meat Morsels. Aside from the standard method of absorbing humans or vampires via his body, Santana can release chunks of his flesh in the shape of leeches, which latch onto and absorb his opponent's blood.
lang.ability.jojorpg.medicinal_usage.desc: The Ripple can heal fractured bones as well as lessen one's sense of pain, allowing Ripple users to use techniques without fear of pain. When Zeppeli uses Forced Ripple Breathing on Jonathan, the latter's breathing heals his fractured arm, which normally would have taken another month or two to comp
lang.ability.jojorpg.medieval_pincer.desc: While hiding in a secret labyrinth, Jack comes across and modifies a medieval torture device. With his strength as a zombie, Jack uses this modified device as a pincer, using its spikes to tear foes and even solid pillars apart.
lang.ability.jojorpg.metal_silver_overdrive.d: Essentially the same as a Sendō Ripple Overdrive, but with the ability to transfer through metal.
lang.ability.jojorpg.needle_vein_strike.desc: All four zombies share the same ability, allowing them to extend veins from the tops of their heads in the direction of their prey in order to suck their blood. If used in a careless manner, these appendages can become entangled.
lang.ability.jojorpg.overdrive.desc: The most basic application of the Ripple. Straizo attacks with either his limbs or an object imbued with the Ripple. He uses it directly onto a chandelier to destroy Page, Jones, Plant, and Bornnam.
lang.ability.jojorpg.overdrive_barrage.desc: When Jonathan jabs fast enough consecutively, he can release multiple Overdrives at once.
lang.ability.jojorpg.poisonous_scimitar.desc: Caineghis utilizes a scimitar infused with poison to eliminate his opponents. He is skilled with wielding it, as he can slash multiple people at the same time while he spins. He can also easily toss and catch his blade.
lang.ability.jojorpg.precognition.desc: The user can predict the future of any individual. Its regular usage allows one to see a few seconds into the future. Extremely skilled users like Tonpetty can see very far into the future of an individual by touching their hands, including their destiny and how they die.
lang.ability.jojorpg.presence_erasing.desc: Sasha is capable of erasing her presence by suppressing her breathing, moving as silently as a snow leopard.
lang.ability.jojorpg.projectile_hand.desc: Stroheim is capable of firing off his mechanical hand with enough force to impale and deeply wound an enemy. Though revealed only towards the end of the arc, Stroheim used it to prevent Kars's escape and pinned him to a plane that went crashing into an active volcano.
lang.ability.jojorpg.rebuff_overdrive.desc: Joseph charges Ripple into his elbows and delivers a powerful strike. This was used during Joseph's fight with Wamuu to retaliate his falling attack.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ribs_blades.desc: Also called Exposed Ribs, Santana is able to control his ribs. Each of them are capable of spinning and moving in any direction. Having a maximum length of and a maximum pressure of per centimeter squared, Santana can use them to either crush or impale his opponents.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ripple_beat.desc: An advanced adhesive technique, Joseph imbues both his fists and feet with the Ripple. To prevent himself from falling down a pillar covered with oil, he flips himself upwards and uses his hands to stick to the blast of oil. He then slides across and propels himself upwards, gaining more distance th
lang.ability.jojorpg.ripple_cutter.desc: Zeppeli spits globs of liquid from between his teeth. The Ripple combined with the liquid makes it sharp and dense enough to cut through solid objects, as well as agile and accurate enough to deflect other projectiles.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ripple_detector.desc: Jonathan imbues a contained liquid or object such as wine with the Ripple. The Ripple will pass through his body and the environment, enabling Jonathan to sense his surroundings and detect others even through walls.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ripple_hair_attack.desc: Joseph infuses his Ripple into strands of hair to make them hard enough to form a barrier, which blocks incoming projectiles. Joseph uses it to block bullets fired by Santana after ripping a fistful of Stroheim's hair.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ripple_hypnosis.desc: Caesar can hypnotize people and animals by using the Ripple on them. The process can involve a kiss or simply touching one's head with their hands. The hypnotized person will act according to his demands and be stronger than an ordinary being, being imbued with the Ripple. Caesar uses it on a woman
lang.ability.jojorpg.ripple_overdrive_beat.de: Joseph traps the opponent with ropes made of 100% wool, then imbues the ropes with the Ripple. It has enough force to slice through Esidisi's face.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ripple_teleferico_ropewa: Lisa Lisa and Sasha both send positive and negative Ripple energy into Sasha's braided cord while holding onto both ends. By doing so, they avoid damaging Octavio and only incapacitate Dos Santos instead, who Octavio was holding onto.
A Ripple Master can use cloth woven from the dried intestinal fibers of the Satiporoja Beetle. The cloth is capable of conducting the Ripple at 100%. Straizo and Lisa Lisa use scarves that are made of 30,000 beetles. As it conducts and disperses the Ripple far better than the human body, it acts sim
lang.ability.jojorpg.satiporoja_beetle_missan: Like Lisa Lisa and Straizo, Sasha utilizes a weapon woven from the dried intestinal fibers of the Satiporoja Beetle. Instead of a scarf like her master, Sasha has a wide braided cord that is around 10 to 20 meters long and capable of conducting the Ripple at 100%. As it conducts and disperses the Ri
lang.ability.jojorpg.saw_hat.desc: Speedwagon wore a bowler hat with a hidden buzz-saw built into it that was sharp enough to cut through bone. Speedwagon used it during his days as a thief, throwing the hat at his opponent as a projectile for a deadly attack. He was extremely proficient with it, being able to juggle with the hat eas
lang.ability.jojorpg.scalpels.desc: Jack uses his immunity to pain to his advantage by inserting sub-dermal scalpels into his body. Once the scalpels are buried in his body, Jack is able to expel them via muscle contraction, shooting the knives over great distances with pinpoint accuracy.
lang.ability.jojorpg.scarlet_overdrive.desc: Charging the Ripple into one hand, Jonathan can create a Ripple of flame. He is able to transfer this flame over to another part of his body, and anything that touches that body part has a chance of catching fire.
lang.ability.jojorpg.seated_jump.desc: Those who have trained in Sendō gain strong legs and knees. Like his grandfather, Caesar is capable of jumping extremely high from a sitting position and then landing on his feet.
lang.ability.jojorpg.sendo_ripple_overdrive.d: Jonathan charges a Ripple wave through his arm and releases it into a solid object, such as a wall or partition. The Ripple can travel through and reach anything on the other side, and anything hit by the Ripple is sent flying in a spiral. If the enemy is an Undead, the Ripple will enter their blood
lang.ability.jojorpg.sendo_wave_kick.desc: A Ripple-infused strike with the knee. The Ripple energy tears vampires and zombies apart upon entering the bloodstream.
lang.ability.jojorpg.sledgehammer.desc: Not being able to master the Ripple didn't stop Speedwagon from helping in the fight. He used a sledgehammer powerful enough to kill zombies in just one strike by smashing their heads. This scene is omitted in the anime, but he still uses the sledgehammer later. In the anime, Speedwagon tries to sma
lang.ability.jojorpg.snake_muffler.desc: Lisa Lisa's primary method of fighting involves a scarf made with the yarn of the Satiporoja Beetle, which can conduct the Ripple at 100%. She can channel her Ripple through her scarf to stand upside down, leaving the now rigid scarf the only part of her in contact with the ground. She may also use
lang.ability.jojorpg.space_ripper_stingy_eyes: Dio is able to pressurize bodily liquid in his eyeballs and then create small openings in his pupils, unleashing two fluid jets with enough power to slice through stone. This ability is later referred to by Straizo as "Space Ripper Stingy Eyes." Dio can also aim this attack to some degree, as he tar
lang.ability.jojorpg.sticking_ripple_and_repe: Caesar is able to use the Ripple as a repellent and to adhere either himself or objects to other objects and liquids. Joseph and Caesar manage to climb a pillar covered in oil with adhesion, and Caesar uses it to deflect a high pressured oil jet. Later, Caesar and Joseph force Esidisi out of Suzi Q'
lang.ability.jojorpg.stone_form.desc: The Pillar Men possess the ability to turn their body to stone and merge with their surroundings. While mainly being used for hibernation, they can also enter this state while awake to defend themselves. In this form they are immune to the Ripple, sunlight and UV lights, and they absorb blood and li
lang.ability.jojorpg.sunlight_yellow_overdriv: Jonathan and Zeppeli have the ability to release devastating Ripple-infused strikes with power comparable to the sun itself. The energy produced by this technique can flow straight through victims to obliterate multiple Undead at once; when delivered through a barrage of punches, it can even revive
Lisa Lisa holds the Red Stone of Aja in one hand and presses it against the opponent before charging it with the Ripple. Her Ripple resembles the color of sunset and creates a red firework, burning the enemy.
lang.ability.jojorpg.switching_winback.desc: A psychological recovery method used by top athletes. When they are under pressure during a match, they can put away their shock, mistakes, and fear deep within their minds. Like flipping a switch, they are able to bring out their fighting spirit. However, they need a ritual in order to flip that sw
lang.ability.jojorpg.thousand_color_overdrive: Lisa Lisa creates a massive electrified dome by imbuing the Ripple on leaves, flowers, and dyed sawdust from destroyed rugs. The materials pile on top of each other in layers to cover an entire plaza from El Señor de las Moscas's swarm of flies.
lang.ability.jojorpg.thunder_cross_split_atta: An advanced version of the Thunder Split Attack that covers its weakness by making his arms form a cross. It is described as a perfect technique in both attack and defense, so no one, aside from Dio, has ever defeated it.
lang.ability.jojorpg.thunder_split_attack.des: Dire jumps at his opponent and does a split with his legs, preventing the opponent from moving their arms. He then attacks his foe's neck with a chop imbued with the Ripple. It's quick enough that Dire is even able to put objects on his opponent without them noticing, as he slips a letter in between
lang.ability.jojorpg.tongue_manipulation.desc: Adams can grow his tongue to abnormal lengths, stretching it long enough to grab his prey.
lang.ability.jojorpg.tornado_overdrive.desc: Zeppeli leaps into the air and points his legs toward his opponent. From here, he is able to move the Ripple to his lower half and essentially dive-bombs the opponent in a spinning motion, much like a drill.
lang.ability.jojorpg.turquoise_blue_overdrive: Appropriately the strongest place to use the Ripple, Jonathan can release high-powered tempests while underwater with enough force to blast enemies away. In most cases, a good portion of the water is propelled outward as well, draining something like a lake to waist-high depth.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ultimate_thing.desc:
As the Ultimate Thing, Kars acquires multiple abilities and skills:
*Superhuman Intelligence: Kars is an extremely intelligent and cunning individual, even by the high standards of his species. After becoming the Ultimate Thing, Kars's intelligence only grows further, to the point that his I.Q. is e
lang.ability.jojorpg.ultraviolet_radiation_ap: The Ultraviolet Radiation Apparatus is one of Stroheim's hidden weapons. Inside Stroheim's mechanized eye is a small laser cannon capable of firing a concentrated beam of Ultraviolet light. The beam itself is five times more intense than a set of typical ultraviolet lights and was able to pierce str

Built by the technical department of the Speedwagon Foundation specifically as an anti-vampire device, Stroheim is able to fire out powerful blasts of ultraviolet light from apparatuses located on each of his shoulders. As miniaturized searchlights, they pack the same power as the original, but are
lang.ability.jojorpg.vaporization_freezing_te:
By vaporizing the moisture in his body, Dio can absorb heat from any living being he comes into physical contact with, freezing them and stifling their blood flow. This ability can be circumvented if Ripple energy is channeled through items or fire.
It is unknown if DIO is able to use Vaporization F
lang.ability.jojorpg.venomous_snakes.desc:
Doobie can control several snakes who live inside his head, including venomous cobras and flesh-eating vipers. He hides them with the sack on his face so he can catch his opponents by surprise, having his snakes extend themselves and bite his opponents when they are off guard.
This technique is not
lang.ability.jojorpg.wind_suit.desc: Wamuu wraps his body in a whirlwind of steam released from his lungs, using make-shift tubes produced from his own body to release the air inside his lungs. The steam grants Wamuu the ability to reflect rays of sunlight off of his body, giving him much needed protection against the sun as well as in
Vampires are capable of creating zombies from either living beings or deceased corpses by injecting them with a vampiric extract. Though zombies are also strong creatures, they are less powerful than their vampiric creator and will often obey them without question. In Stardust Crusaders, DIO perfect
lang.ability.jojorpg.zoom_punch.desc: Jonathan launches his fist forward and strikes his opponent. First used by Zeppeli, the attack involves a Ripple breathing technique that dislocates and stretches the joints to extend the arm and give it greater reach while also using the same Ripple to dull the pain caused by the move. Due to the i
lang.item.jojorpg.boxing_gloves.lore: Worn knuckles from the slums of London.
lang.item.jojorpg.breathing_mask.lore: A training mask that only lets you breathe the Ripple way. Wear it long enough and the breath becomes yours.
lang.item.jojorpg.cybernetic_overhaul.lore: Blueprints of the German Army's finest science - the body of Rudol von Stroheim.
lang.item.jojorpg.pillar_remains.lore: A fragment of the pillar the Pillar Men slept in for 12,000 years.
lang.item.jojorpg.red_stone_of_aja.lore: The Super Aja: focused through the Stone Mask, it makes a Pillar Man the Ultimate Life Form.
lang.item.jojorpg.stone_mask.lore: An Aztec relic. Blood on its face drives bone spikes into the wearer's brain - and unlocks it.
lang.lineage.jojorpg.brawler.desc: Ogre Street toughness and gentleman boxing: no powers, just fists, grit and whatever weapon is at hand.
lang.lineage.jojorpg.cyborg.desc: German science is the best in the world! An armoured body with built-in machine guns and an ultraviolet lamp.
lang.lineage.jojorpg.hamon.desc: Rhythmic breathing turns the body into a battery of sunlight energy. Breathe (stand still or crouch) to refill the Ripple; your blows sear vampires, zombies and Pillar Men. You can walk on water.
lang.lineage.jojorpg.pillar_man.desc: An ancient being above vampires: you absorb living things through your skin and master the Modes - but sunlight turns you to stone until the Red Stone of Aja makes you the Ultimate Life Form.
lang.lineage.jojorpg.vampire.desc: The Stone Mask made you immortal: monstrous strength, regeneration and blood that heals you with every bite - but the sun turns you to ash and the Ripple burns.
